zhi khro rab 'byams rtsa gsum kun 'dus gsang ba sngags kyi rgyud
item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyig ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can la/ gter bdag ye shes dbal mo'i (mos) lung bstan nas/ chu byi hor zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer gsum la/ lho rgyal mo tsha ba rong chen ngo mtshar phun 'tshogs bkod pa'i zhing khams/ bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro sku yi bkod pa rdzogs pa'i thugs ka'i g.yas phyogs/ gnas mchog bkra shis spungs pa'i ri bo/ brag ri mtshon cha bshib 'dra'i g.yas rgyab/ 'byung ba brag gi them bar/ lha shing ljon pa'i rtsa ba nas gter la spyan drangs te/ slad mar shing pho stag gi lo hor zla bzhi pa'i yar tshes la/ mdangs ldan g.yung drung gling du shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba dge'o/ 'gro ba sems can gyi don du mdzad pa'i 'gro don rgya che bar shog bkra shis dpal 'bar bon bstan mtharaM rgyas shog/
